policy: Development only before held-out outcome inspection. Keep trials, task-matched controls, failures and incomplete arms. Never impute missing measurements. Count unsuccessful attempts in cost. No extra spending after a per-arm bound; report denominator. Labels are scoring-only. Historical November 1 results separate.
split: 88 dev / 310 test, primary annotation by official file order; discordance sensitivity
measure: rescued true success, newly released genuine failure, success recall, FPR, calls per trajectory; paired task bootstrap 95% intervals
guard: no increase in heldout false accept count; distinguish coverage; sensitivity on disputed labels; all failures with any labels remain in coverage.
budget: max 1300 output tokens per call; ceiling 30 USD projected per main run; publish observed usage
